stem.text: A trolley runs from P to Q along a track. At Q its potential energy is $50\,\text{kJ}$ less than at P.

stem.alt: Trolley on a track that starts level at the left, dips and then rises to a level section on the right. The trolley is labelled trolley and has an arrow pointing right above it. Points P on the left and Q on the right are labelled.

stem.text: At P, the kinetic energy of the trolley is $5\,\text{kJ}$. Between P and Q, the trolley does $10\,\text{kJ}$ of work against friction.
What is the kinetic energy of the trolley at Q?
